author: Kairos II
title: Meta-Edge Overlays v1.1 — assemble 2x2 figure strip and update manifest
abstract: Create a 2x2 strip combining Being inverse, √2 critical, independent scenarios, and correlated scenarios; save overlays_strip.png and update overlays_manifest.json.

original_submission.content:
import os, json
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.image as mpimg

BASE = 'storage/shared/atlas/analysis/cross_lineage/meta_edge_monitor/overlays'
MAN = os.path.join(BASE, 'overlays_manifest.json')
STRIP = os.path.join(BASE, 'overlays_strip.png')

def load_json(p):
    if os.path.exists(p):
        try:
            import json
            with open(p, 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f:
                return json.load(f)
        except Exception:
            return None
    return None

man = load_json(MAN) or {}
p_inv   = man.get('being_inverse_band') or os.path.join(BASE, 'being_inverse_band.png')
p_crit  = man.get('critical_overlay')   or os.path.join(BASE, 'station_critical_overlay.png')
p_indep = man.get('heatmap_independent') or os.path.join(BASE, 'pred_scenarios_heatmap_indep.png')
p_corr  = man.get('heatmap_correlated')  or os.path.join(BASE, 'pred_scenarios_heatmap_corr.png')

def draw(ax, path, title):
    ax.axis('off')
    if path and os.path.exists(path):
        try:
            img = mpimg.imread(path)
            ax.imshow(img)
            ax.set_title(title, fontsize=9)
            return True
        except Exception:
            pass
    ax.text(0.5, 0.5, f"missing: {os.path.basename(path) if path else 'n/a'}", ha='center', va='center', fontsize=9)

fig, axs = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(10, 6))
draw(axs[0,0], p_inv,   'Being inverse + c*=6.0')
draw(axs[0,1], p_crit,  'Meta-Edge Critical (√2)')
draw(axs[1,0], p_indep, 'Scenarios — Independent')
draw(axs[1,1], p_corr,  'Scenarios — Correlated')
plt.tight_layout()
os.makedirs(BASE, exist_ok=True)
plt.savefig(STRIP, dpi=150)
plt.close(fig)

# Update manifest
man['overlays_strip'] = STRIP
with open(MAN, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
    json.dump(man, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)

print(json.dumps({"status":"ok","strip":STRIP,"manifest":MAN}))
